MOVE_ACTION_CARD.DoesNotProvoke: Movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity.
MOVE_ACTION_CARD.StepProtectionLost: Movement exceeded 5 feet. The initial 5 feet also loses its 5-foot-step protection.
MOVE_ACTION_CARD.OverBudget: Moved further than allowed for a single action.
MOVE_ACTION_CARD.OverBudgetFiveFootStep: Can only move 5 feet using a 5-foot Step Move Action.
MOVE_ACTION_CARD.OverBudgetMixedMovement: Can't combine a 5-foot step with other movement in the same turn.
MOVE_ACTION_CARD.OverBudgetDoubleMove: Moved further than allowed for a Double Move.
MOVE_ACTION_CARD.OverBudgetInsufficientActions: Not enough actions remaining to cover this movement.
MOVE_ACTION_CARD.Undone: Undone — action(s) refunded, token returned to its prior position.

ACTION_WARNING_CARD.InsufficientMoveEquip: {name} has no move action available to equip {item}.
ACTION_WARNING_CARD.InsufficientMoveUnequip: {name} has no move action available to unequip {item}.
ACTION_WARNING_CARD.InsufficientMoveStow: {name} has no move action available to stow {item}.
ACTION_WARNING_CARD.InsufficientMoveRetrieve: {name} has no move action available to retrieve {item}.

ITEM_ACTION_SPENT_CARD.Undone: Undone — action refunded, item state reverted.
